description: A prompt test of the proposal: its directory in the draft directory and what the contract says about it. The scenario, workspace files and test cases live in the directory's files, not here.

directory.description: The prompt test's directory relative to the draft directory, with / separators, such as .cat/tests/rules/notes/long_document. It holds scenario.md, values.json and an optional workspace/ directory. Its last name is the prompt test's identifier, in snake_case. A recorded prompt test keeps its directory; a new one lies directly in the target's test directory.

assertions.description: The requirement that each assertion of the scenario's ## Assertions section checks, one item per assertion. Each requirement that the test proves has at least one assertion.

id.description: The assertion's id, the ### heading of its subsection in scenario.md.

requirement_id.description: The requirement whose compliance the assertion shows. The test must prove it.
